collisionPolicy.newParts: All visible new parts have closed authored geometry and analytic finite collision volumes of the same dimensions; rounded render shapes use conservative closed OBB proxies (no outside gap). Torus uses analytic closed torus, cylinders use closed cylinders. Connected overlapping joins are intentional union solids, not independent force layers.
collisionPolicy.newRoundedBoxes: collision OBB includes bevel voids conservatively; human receiver must test OBB, not only rendered skin
collisionPolicy.retainedSources: All original surviving triangles participate irrespective of visibility: reviewed closed components keep interiors; every retained triangle additionally has symmetric4mm closed triangular-prism proxy (+/-2mm). This is an explicit simulator guard thickness, not inferred vessel material; classify topology before using interior parity.
collisionPolicy.replacementMeaning: Enumerated source faces/components are physically retired from this variant AND rendering, not hidden collision exclusions; other faces remain bit-exact. Baseline restores on dispose.
collisionPolicy.allEdges: No unreviewed body-edge/source-face or source-edge/body-face crossing; permitted contact only when entire contacting element projects inside named finite patch
collisionPolicy.garment: Included in full-body geometry; no visual-only garment exemption; only named finite cushion/back patch allowances above
collisionPolicy.swept: Future receiving acceptance requires continuous collision/conservative advancement on all body vertices/edges and source faces plus articulated parts. Sampling endpoints/AABBs alone cannot pass; any unknown closed-volume/self-intersection/coplanar case remains unavailable.
